comfyui.validated_with: ComfyUI 0.12.3, frontend 1.38.13 (local); RunPod images run ComfyUI 0.20-0.24 with frontend 1.42-1.44
comfyui.requires: a ComfyUI build that includes the core Switch node (ComfySwitchNode, comfy_extras/nodes_logic.py, added December 2025) and the core Primitive nodes; subgraph support in the frontend (1.24 or newer)

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI_essentials
custom_nodes.validated_version: 1.1.0 (commit 9d9f4be, same pin as the RunPod images)
custom_nodes.why: Resizing with conditions, tile/untile grid for tiled processing, size maths (tile rows/cols, steps/denoise from creativity), batch/list conversion.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Inpaint-CropAndStitch
custom_nodes.validated_version: 3.0.17 (node interface verified; RunPod image installs main)
custom_nodes.why: Crops the (masked) working area with context, pre-resizes it to 1280-5120 px and blends the enhanced crop back into the original.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Impact-Pack
custom_nodes.why: Body and face detailing (detect, segment, re-render) and batch-to-list conversion for per-tile processing.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack
custom_nodes.why: Loads the YOLOv8 person/face detectors used by the detailers (needs the ultralytics Python package).

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts
custom_nodes.why: Builds the prompts (custom prompt + style tags, base prompt + per-tile caption) with the same tidy/append rules as the app.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-QwenVL
custom_nodes.validated_version: 2.0.0 local / 2.3.1 at the pinned commit (same inputs and custom-prompt behaviour); RunPod Klein image: 2.1.1
custom_nodes.why: Qwen3-VL captioning: per-tile captions in General Enhancement, the bvfinish prompt in RAW Enhancement. First-frame caption in LTX 2.5.
custom_nodes.extra: Needs llama-cpp-python built with CUDA and vision (mtmd) support. The RunPod images use JamePeng/llama-cpp-python wheels (v0.3.30 cu128 basic, v0.3.49 cu128).

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
custom_nodes.why: Pass-through helpers and the 512 px resize that feeds the tile captioner. Also counts, selects, repeats and concatenates video frames in LTX 2.5. These interfaces are present at the existing pin.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-post-processing-nodes
custom_nodes.why: The Sharpen control: blends each tile with its 1x-ReFocus version.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Easy-Use
custom_nodes.why: Re-batches the enhanced tiles before untiling (kept as in the app so results stay identical).

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-nunchaku
custom_nodes.validated_version: 1.2.1 (RunPod images); local 1.2.0 has the same loader inputs
custom_nodes.why: Loads the SVDQuant (4-bit) Fluxmania Legacy model used for the Flux passes.
custom_nodes.extra: Also install the matching nunchaku wheel from https://github.com/nunchux-ai/nunchaku/releases/tag/v1.2.1 (e.g. nunchaku-1.2.1+cu12.8torch2.10-cp312-cp312-linux_x86_64.whl for torch 2.10 / CUDA 12.8 / Python 3.12). The repositories were renamed from nunchaku-tech and nunchaku-ai; old URLs redirect.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler
custom_nodes.validated_version: 2.5.24 (the saved workflow node was created with 2.5.14; inputs are unchanged)

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite
custom_nodes.validated_version: 1.7.9; source and live node interfaces inspected
custom_nodes.why: Loads video frames and source audio; saves H.264 MP4 with audio.
custom_nodes.extra: Needs FFmpeg (libx264/AAC); requirements include imageio-ffmpeg and opencv-python.

custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
custom_nodes.validated_version: Pinned sampler source inspected; full LTX 2.5 inference not executed
custom_nodes.why: Refines upscaled video latents in overlapping temporal windows.
custom_nodes.extra: Requires recent ComfyUI with LTX 2.5 support; reviewed against ComfyUI 0.37.0. This graph uses the core model, encoder and VAE loaders.
